mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (STUDENTID, PWD, MAJOR, NAME, EMAIL1, EMAIL2, PHONE, AUTHORITY, REGDATE) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{pwd}, #{major}, #{name}, #{email1}, #{email2}, #{phone}, 1, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET PWD = #{pwd}, MAJOR = #{major}, NAME = #{name}, EMAIL1 = #{email1}, EMAIL2 = #{email2}, PHONE = #{phone} WHERE STUDENTID = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT STUDENTID, MAJOR, NAME, EMAIL1, EMAIL2, PHONE, AUTHORITY, REGDATE FROM MEMBER WHERE AUTHORITY = 1 ORDER BY REGDATE DESC
